caption: The video captures a modern building exterior, with a reflective glass curtain wall filling the left and center and a beige concrete building with narrow windows to the right. The glass mirrors a dusk sky with scattered clouds, a pink horizon glow, and warm yellow interior reflections. Throughout the clip, the framing drifts slowly and continuously, the reflected horizon and pink glow holding roughly their height while sliding rightward. The vertical mullions and the glass-to-concrete corner shift rightward, while the concrete building's window rows slide downward. As different panels enter view, the yellow interior reflection shifts and becomes more prominent toward the center-right. The mirrored scene changes mainly through smooth camera parallax.
relations: Slow camera parallax causes the reflected horizon and pink glow to slide rightward across the glass panels.
Drifting framing shifts the vertical mullions and the glass-to-concrete corner rightward across the view.
The camera's continuous drift makes the concrete building's window rows slide downward.
As new panels enter view, the yellow interior reflection shifts and becomes more prominent toward the center-right.
